content:
Nuevo Laredo's cemeteries are ready to receive more than 20,000 visitors for Día de Muertos, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo. The report, published Tuesday evening, puts the city's burial grounds in full readiness just days before the Nov. 1-2 observance.

Día de Muertos is one of the most widely observed traditions on both sides of the border, when families visit cemeteries to honor their dead, clean and decorate graves, and gather in remembrance. A turnout of more than 20,000 visitors makes the city's cemeteries among the busiest public spaces in Nuevo Laredo during the observance.

The readiness report comes as Nuevo Laredo closes out its Halloween week programming and turns toward the Day of the Dead weekend, when foot traffic at cemeteries traditionally peaks.

Sources:

  • El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, "Día de Muertos: panteones de Nuevo Laredo están listos para recibir a más de 20 mil visitantes," Oct. 27, 2026
